title: Lightning Bane Cave
body:
The Lightning Bane Cave is a located in the Finlay Taiga, behind Alan's AutoLogistics. It is unlocked by having lightning strike 4 lightning rods (done by using Michael's copper axe. Once opened it stays open for the entirety of the server's runtime.

This location is primarily used to craft the lightningbane pickaxe. Once someone crafts it, it can not be crafted by anyone else in that server.

Disclaimer: Attempting to unlock this area may take multiple copper axes and a few hours of waiting for thunderstorms and lightning strikes.
